maria-ops: quick sync after the postmortem. I'm consolidating follow-ups into a short sprint ahead of the next DR rehearsal. Please drop ETAs here. Main problems: flapping multi-region routing, missing restore runbook steps, and snapshot verification failures.

aj-sre: taking A1 (routing stabilization). Plan: enforce route preference, add DNS TTL checks, canary in eu-west Tue, roll Wed. ETA Wed EOD.

dee-eng: taking A2 (backup validation). Discovered S3 lifecycle tag mismatch in us-east. Revalidate Thu, if green add automated smoke restore. ETA Fri.

samir-ml: recurring pattern: KV rebuild storms after failover due to short cache TTLs. Proposing TTLs -> 90s + jitter and warmers. Draft RFC this afternoon.

karen-platform: A3 runbook edits in progress (manual cutover checklist, optional BGP prep note, DNS expectations). Need infra reviewer @aj-sre please.

aj-sre: will review PR today. Suggest keep BGP prep optional but call out propagation risk.

maria-ops: agreed. Write into checklist: "If BGP prep skipped expect longer DNS propagation and verify via dig".

opsbot: Reminder: DR rehearsal scheduled 2024-11-12 15:00 UTC. Channels: #game-day, #oncall. Runbook v2.1.

aj-sre: FYI canary logs show intermittent 502 on region-egress path, tagging infra-network for follow-up. snippet: "[2024-11-05T09:14:02Z] route-egress: 502 upstream_timeout region=us-east-1"

dee-eng: adding restore checklist entry for network-specific 502 fallback steps.

karen-platform: granted dee-eng temporary access to validation cluster until Fri; added IAM checklist item.

maria-ops: action matrix:
A1: routing policy + DNS checks 1 owner aj-sre 1 ETA Wed EOD
A2: backup validation + smoke restore 1 owner dee-eng 1 ETA Fri
A3: runbook edits + PR review 1 owner karen-platform 1 merge by Thu
A4: cache TTL + warmers 1 owner samir-ml 1 RFC today -> rollout next week

samir-ml: updated thread with RFC link (draft). aiming to stage tests this week.

karen-platform: PR merged after review. runbook bumped to v2.2 (commit 7a2c9d).

maria-ops: reconvene Fri 16:00 UTC for status huddle. update ETAs by EOD Thu if anything changes. I'll compile playbook feedback after game day.

aj-sre: :thumbsup:

dee-eng: smoke restore logs will be uploaded to /backups/smoke-logs/3332102468

maria-ops: closing thread; reopen if slips.
